content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to successful digital commerce in Kenya lies in infrastructure sovereignty. By owning your own digital stack, you're not reliant on platforms that can change their terms or shut you down at any moment. This infrastructure is built on Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, providing a robust and decentralized payment system that works seamlessly with cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron. With this setup, you can sell ebooks to international buyers without worrying about platform restrictions or fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential components. You'll need a Cloudflare account for hosting and security, a GitHub account for version control, and a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency payments. You'll also need to set up a digital wallet for storing your cryptocurrencies. Once you have these components in place, you can start building your stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is the heart of your digital commerce stack. You'll need to set up a Supabase database for storing order information, a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket for storing and delivering digital products, and a NOWPayments integration for processing cryptocurrency payments. With this pipeline in place, you can start selling ebooks to international buyers and delivering them instantly.
You can sell ebooks from Kenya without a Stripe account by leveraging blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your digital commerce stack is a straightforward process. You'll need to configure your Cloudflare Pages site, set up your NOWPayments integration, and add your digital products to your Supabase database. Once everything is in place, you can start processing transactions and delivering ebooks to your customers. With this setup, you can expect to have your first transaction processed in under 60 seconds, with a fee of under $0.10.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running
